gettingStarted.intro: Set up your pet in a minute, then let PawPawCare keep track of what's due.

addPet.title: Add your pet
addPet.body: Tap “Add your first pet” on Home, or “Add another pet” on the Pets tab. Only the name is required.
addPet.step1: Choose dog, cat, or “Rabbit, bird or other”.
addPet.step2: Give them a name. A photo, breed and color are optional.
addPet.step3: Add their birthday, weight and more, or tap “Skip for now”. You can fill these in later.

records.title: Add vaccines and medications
records.body: Open your pet's profile and go to Health. In “Vaccination tracker”, tap “Add vaccine”: a name and a due date are all it needs. “Add medication” asks for a name, a dose, how often, and the times of day.

home.title: Read your Home screen
home.body: The headline tells you what needs you: anything overdue first, then vaccines due in the next 30 days. The first card shows the most urgent vaccine, with “Mark done” and “Reschedule”. “Today” lists today's medications, and “Coming up” the next 7 days. “All caught up” means nothing is overdue or due soon, and no medication is waiting for today.

ai.title: Let AI read a vet document
ai.body: In the “Medical vault”, upload a photo of a vet record, then tap “Read with AI”. It suggests vaccines, medications, weight, cost and clinic details. Nothing is saved until you check the suggestions and tap “Apply”.

reminders.intro: Most reminders set themselves up. You only add the extras.

automatic.title: Reminders that set themselves up
automatic.body: Every vaccine you add gets a reminder 7 days before it's due, at 9:00. Every medication gets one at each dose time, repeating as often as the medication does; “As needed” medications get none. Everyone who shares the pet gets them too, and marking a vaccine done cancels its reminder.

custom.title: Add your own
custom.body: For anything else, like a vet visit or a refill, open “Reminders” and add one with a date and a time. From the same list you can switch any reminder off, or delete it.

inbox.title: Your notification inbox
inbox.body: Tapping a notification opens your inbox (the bell on Home), where you can snooze a reminder for an hour or dismiss it.

phone.title: If notifications don't arrive
phone.body: Reminders are scheduled on your phone, so they arrive even when you're offline. If notifications aren't allowed for PawPawCare, a banner at the top of the Reminders screen says so, and its button turns them on or opens your phone's settings. Also check Profile → Notifications → “Care reminders”, which turns reminders on or off on this phone only.

doses.title: Log each dose
doses.body: Tap “Log” when you give a medication. The “Today” card on Home then shows how many of today's doses have been given.

sharing.intro: Share the care with family, your vet or a sitter, without sharing your password.

invite.title: Invite family to co-own a pet
invite.body: On your pet's profile, open “Care team” and send an invite to their email address. Co-owners can view and update records; only you can delete the pet or manage the care team.

accept.title: Accept an invitation
accept.body: We don't email invitations, so let them know to open Profile → “Pet sharing & invites”. The first time, they confirm their email address with a 6-digit code; invitations sent to that address then appear there, ready to accept.

vet.title: Share with your vet
vet.body: “Share with vet” creates a read-only web link to vaccinations, medications, weight and recent documents. Choose 1 hour, 24 hours or 7 days; your vet needs no app or account. “Revoke all active links” switches every link off at once.

sitter.title: Hand over to a sitter
sitter.body: “Caretaker handoff” holds feeding notes, instructions and an emergency contact, plus a link you can text to your sitter, valid from 1 day to 2 weeks. Anyone with the link can read it, so leave out door codes and alarm PINs.

export.title: Export your records
export.body: Profile → “Export health records” creates a PDF or CSV of vaccinations, medications, appointments, weights and clinics, for any of your pets. It's free, forever.
